name: agent-secret-vault
description: Use a local macOS vault for encrypted agent secrets without returning plaintext to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use encrypted secret references without exposing plaintext.
interface.longDescription: Agent Secret Vault connects Codex to a local macOS app over authenticated IPC. Codex can request status, create secret references, request local reveal, and run secure executions, but plaintext remains in the app boundary.
defaultPrompt: Create a secret reference from selected text.
Run a secure command using secret:// references.
